name: Shan Gui Er
source:
As the autumn come, sweet osmanthus's fragrant is pervading Zijin Mountain again.
This is an AVG game produced by Magenta Factory, follow the story line of Shan Gui and Bai Qu, with an innovative mange-style display.

The story tells about He Jia and Han Hui's reunion, in the sweet and mild autumn season.
You will be guided by the girls, once again, enjoy a fantastic autumn journey of the ancient Chinese city of Nanjing.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/952420/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
秋天来临，紫金山再次弥漫甜美桂花香。这是洋红工房制作的AVG，以创新的漫画风格画面讲述《山桂》与《百曲》的故事。

故事讲述贺佳与韩卉在甜美温和的秋季重逢。跟随女孩们的引导，再次享受中国古城南京奇妙的秋日旅程。

[改编自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/952420/]Steam[/url]]
